description: Village-level data on population, drinking water, MGNREGA and funds
summary: This page shows village-level data for the gram panchayats in this district: population, households, drinking water coverage, road connectivity, MGNREGA works, and the funds each panchayat received and used, from eGramSwaraj and NREGA.nic.in. Amounts are shown in lakh rupees (1 lakh = ₹1,00,000).
urbanBody: {district} is a fully urban district governed by a Municipal Corporation. Gram Panchayat and MGNREGA data applies only to rural areas.
municipalBodyText: Responsible for urban governance, civic amenities and infrastructure in {district}
urbanSource: Data sourced from the District NIC portal and the Municipal Corporation website.
emptyBody: We are collecting village-level MGNREGA works and fund utilisation data from eGramSwaraj.
fundsExplainer: Out of every ₹100 given to the {n} gram panchayats, about ₹{used} has been used.

waterSimple: {n} of {total} panchayats report full (100%) drinking water coverage.
